evidence_class: fakeredis swarm store and inbox, a fixture ledger document with four phases and two master seats; no live swarm. Live G10 qualification is separate.
interfaces: masters.seats(slug, count): master@slug (the lead, the address every single master swarm already uses) then master-2@slug up to master-N@slug; a count below one is refused

MasterSeats.owners(slug, doc): every ledger phase has exactly one owning seat, saved in the swarm's masters hash; a phase keeps a seat that still exists, an unowned phase goes to the seat owning fewest (ties to the lower seat), and a newly added seat takes the busiest seats' last phases up to an even share
masters.route(target, doc, owners, live, lead): a phase or task item reaches the live master owning its phase, anything else and any item whose owner seat has no live master reaches the lead
masters.lead_of(slug, live): the lead seat while it is live, else the lowest numbered live master
agentihooks swarm SLUG set masters=N: stores the master seat count after every other pair is checked and reports it

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards on the pull request
supported_versions.compatibility: A swarm with no stored count has one master seat at the existing master address, so single master swarms route exactly as before (INV-R11)

states.observed: Owners are computed from the ledger phases and the stored count on each read
states.committed: Owners and the seat list are written to the masters hash under a watch; a clashing write is retried and refused by name after five attempts
states.externally_verified: None; no live multi master swarm yet

authoritative_objects: The swarm masters hash in Redis holds the seat count, the phase owners and the seat list they were assigned against
The ledger document stays the single writer of phases and tasks; this package never writes it

rollback_rehearsal.action: agentihooks swarm SLUG set masters=1: every phase returns to the lead and every item routes to the single master address
rollback_rehearsal.data_safety: Lowering the count only reassigns owners of removed seats; no inbox item or ledger record is deleted

remaining_limitations: The tick does not yet launch or respawn masters in seats two and up; filed as a ledger follow up
Hive ownership is not delivered; a seat owns phases only; filed as a ledger follow up

validation.unit: Focused proofs https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38069851670 on the tested commit: every master seats and ledger events test passed, 166 passed; the three package case tests ran each case twice on independent fakeredis servers and failed only because the committed case records were placeholders, whose observed records this commit holds
validation.mutation: Mutation preflight https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38063779158 on the restacked parent left 47 survivors in masters, ledger events and the swarm command; dead defaults were removed and exact tests added in 6e2e86d4
validation.local: No local tests or mutation ran; static prepush passed on every commit

decisions: Seat one keeps the existing master address so a single master swarm routes exactly as before
Owners stay put unless a seat is added, because owners must not change under running work
An item whose owner seat has no live master goes to the lead; with the lead seat empty the lowest numbered live master answers

input_preparation.met_by: tests/sv2_mst01_cases.py builds the four phase two seat fixture from tests/fixtures/swarm_v2/master-seats.json

output_contract.met_by: Four phases split two and two; a task comment on a phase owned by master-2 reaches master-2 only; unaddressed chat reaches the lead

rejection_contract.met_by: An owner seat with no live master never strands an item; a count below one or not a whole number is refused by name

recovery_contract.met_by: A removed seat's phases move while every other phase keeps its owner; a re-read after a restart returns the saved owners

mutation_scope.met_by: Only the masters hash and inbox items change; the ledger document is never written
